messages:
avery: heads-up: deploy-bot proposed bump v2.3.7 -> v2.3.8 after merging #8790 (infra: s3 lifecycle + ci tweak). The PR only touches infra/ and .github/workflows. Should we actually bump the public semver?

leo: if it's purely infra + CI, i'd prefer no semver bump. We already get buildmeta on the commit. Publishing a new patch clutters release notes and skews changelogs for customers.

jamie: agree. tiny nuance: sometimes infra changes require coordinated runtime rollouts (e.g., feature flags or migration flips). In those cases bumping helps visibility. This one looks safe.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: I scanned the PR. Changed paths: ["infra/s3/", ".github/workflows/ci.yml"]. Current rule: auto-patch-on-merge unless PR title contains one of [skip-patch, no-bump]. No path-based overrides enabled.

ops-rotation: quick Q — is there any SLA or rollout dependency for this infra change? ops will need to know if we need to pause automated infra applies.

avery: no runtime migration. Just lifecycle policy + lint fix in CI. Ops: no pause required.

leo: proposal: change the deploy-bot policy to skip patch bumps by default for PRs that only touch these roots: infra/, deploy/, docs/, .github/, tools/. Add an explicit [force-patch] tag to force a bump. That keeps the conservative behavior.

jamie: i'm +1 but we should keep a visible changelog category for infra-only entries labeled "ops/infrastructure" so internal and SRE teams can track. Not in customer-facing release notes though.

deploy-bot: I can implement path-based heuristics. Suggested algorithm: if all changed files match regex ^(infra|deploy|docs|tools|\.github)\/ then do not bump unless PR title includes [force-patch]. Otherwise, fallback to existing title markers. I will open a config PR and add a test harness. ETA: 3 business days.

avery: operationally we should also add a checkbox to the PR template: "Non-customer-facing infra/config change (skip patch bump)". It helps reviewers and maintainers. Jamie, can you add the changelog section for ops/infrastructure?

jamie: will add a small subsection in the release notes generator: `ops_changes` array that is excluded from the external changelog export. I'll send a draft PR.

leo: can we avoid force pushes on tags? If we decide to not bump after the bot created a tag, we should retire the automatic tag and write an internal note instead of force-rewriting tags. Force pushes cause downstream CI confusion.

deploy-bot: current workflow: create tag vX.Y.Z after merge and open release draft. We can change to create a draft note and only create a public tag when bump decision is confirmed. Option: create lightweight internal tag `internal/vX.Y.Z-<sha>` and only publish `vX.Y.Z` when approved. I'll prototype that in the PR.

ops-rotation: sounds good. For rollbacks: if an infra PR needs rollback, the steps are the same as app: revert PR, reapply via infra pipeline, and record the revert in ops_changes. We should document an ops playbook.

avery: action items: leo and jamie — create PRs for PR-template checkbox + changelog ops section. deploy-bot — PR for path-aware heuristics and internal tagging flow. I'll hold off on publishing v2.3.8; marking this as internal-only change.

jamie: noted. i'll draft the ops playbook and add a link in release procedures.

leo: thank you. resolving here. :white_check_mark:
